id.description: Stable identifier. Letters, digits and . _ - ~ @ +. Generated IDs read like EW-WOOD~fc~ply~2x6@16+fg~gx.

mm.description: A length in millimeters. All lengths are stored in mm and converted only for display.

lineRole.description: Line weight is assigned by role, never by number. The pen table maps a role to mm per scale.

function.description: What a layer does in the assembly. Walls run exterior to interior; floors run top to bottom.

source.description: Citation for the ratings, e.g. a UL design number. null means TODO-SOURCE: no rating may be shown as verified.
